title: Prune duplicate packaged Fourfold hybrid retrieval stack
finding: After PRs 311, 312 and 262 were merged on 2026-09-04, main contained two independent Fourfold-hybrid implementations. The packaged daedalus.twin contraction/hybrid/compiler stack also reintroduced the ContractionPlan/ReferenceContractionInterpreter layer that the canonical Fourfold Tensor kernel contract explicitly records as pruned by G1-TENSOR-01CV for duplicating validation, operation budgeting and TypedRelationBlock execution. Repository search found no production consumer outside the packaged hybrid stack's own tests and workflow imports.
gardener_decision: Retain the merged PR/commit/blob history and the contained experiments/fourfold_hybrid_retrieval implementation as evidence. Remove only the duplicate live packaged implementation, its dedicated tests and redundant workflow; keep the canonical TensorView, semirings, TypedRelationBlock, strict relation projection, GPU probe, latent experiment and Fourfold authority unchanged.

changed.purpose: Remove import smoke for the retired duplicate modules while retaining the existing integrated Fourfold/Tensor contract workflow.

added.purpose: Prevent the second packaged hybrid stack from regrowing while requiring the retained contained experiment to remain available as evidence.

retained_evidence.note: No historical PR, commit, blob, work-packet record or archive anchor was deleted or rewritten.

verification.full_suite: not executed; manual-only job skipped on pull_request
